The mean homework grade prior to 2020 was 70.02, based on 10 classes taught between 2016 and 2020.
The homework grades using the free system, based on 4 classes taught between 2020 and 2022, are listed in
. Test the claim that the mean homework grades were higher using the free system. In other words,
test that the mean homework grade of students using the free system (MyOpenMath) is higher than 70.02.
If you read this carefully, you will notice several clues that we are to conduct a hypothesis test for a
population mean. Most notable, the second to last sentence asks us to “test that the mean homework
grade... is higher than 70.02”. The word “mean” appears three times in the second paragraph, so we
are very clearly going to use a hypothesis test for a mean.
As usual, the null hypothesis is the status quo, that there is no change in the homework
scores using the free system compared to the publisher’s system. The alternative
hypothesis is that the mean homework score is higher using the free system.
, this is a right tailed test.
